body.en: IUDs are inserted into the uterus by doctors or trained nurses through the vagina. They may be non-medicated (Lippes loop), copper-releasing (CuT, Cu7, Multiload 375) or hormone-releasing (Progestasert, LNG-20). They increase phagocytosis of sperm in the uterus; Cu ions suppress sperm motility and fertilising capacity; hormone-releasing IUDs make the uterus unsuitable for implantation and the cervix hostile to sperm. IUDs are ideal for women who want to delay pregnancy or space children.
body.kn: IUDಗಳು ಔಷಧರಹಿತ (ಲಿಪ್ಪೆಸ್ ಲೂಪ್), ತಾಮ್ರ ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುವ (CuT, Cu7, ಮಲ್ಟಿಲೋಡ್ 375) ಅಥವಾ ಹಾರ್ಮೋನು ಬಿಡುಗಡೆ ಮಾಡುವ (ಪ್ರೊಜೆಸ್ಟಾಸರ್ಟ್, LNG-20) ಆಗಿರಬಹುದು. ತಾಮ್ರ ಅಯಾನುಗಳು ವೀರ್ಯಾಣುಗಳ ಚಲನೆಯನ್ನು ಕುಗ್ಗಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

title.en: Board: IUDs, hormonal and surgical methods

say.en: Apart from natural and barrier methods, there are three more groups: intra-uterine devices, hormonal methods and surgical methods.
IUDs may be non-medicated, copper-releasing or hormone-releasing. Pills are taken for 21 days; Saheli is a once-a-week pill. Vasectomy and tubectomy are terminal.
How they work: IUDs raise phagocytosis of sperm; copper ions lower sperm motility; hormone IUDs make the uterus unsuitable for implantation.
Pills inhibit ovulation and implantation and change the cervical mucus. In sterilisation a small part of the vas deferens or oviduct is cut and tied, so gametes cannot meet.
Board: IUDs, hormonal and surgical methods.

text.en: Combined progestogen–estrogen pill taken for 21 days

explanation.en: IUDs: Lippes loop, CuT, Cu7, Multiload 375, Progestasert and LNG-20. Hormonal: daily pills, Saheli (weekly, non-steroidal, from CDRI Lucknow), injections and implants. Surgical: vasectomy and tubectomy, which are terminal and poorly reversible.

say.en: Sort these methods into intra-uterine devices, oral or injected hormones, and surgical terminal methods.

body.en: Oral *pills* contain progestogens or progestogen–estrogen combinations, taken daily for 21 days. They inhibit ovulation and implantation and change the cervical mucus to block sperm. Saheli, a once-a-week non-steroidal pill, was developed at CDRI, Lucknow. The same hormones can be given as injections or implants under the skin. Progestogens, alone or with estrogens, taken within 72 hours of coitus work as emergency contraceptives. Surgical methods, or sterilisation, are terminal: vasectomy cuts and ties a small part of the vas deferens; tubectomy does the same to the fallopian tube. Reversibility is very poor.
body.kn: ಗರ್ಭನಿರೋಧಕ ಮಾತ್ರೆಗಳು ಅಂಡೋತ್ಸರ್ಗ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂತರ್ನಿವೇಶನವನ್ನು ತಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಸಹೇಲಿ ವಾರಕ್ಕೊಮ್ಮೆ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವ ಸ್ಟೀರಾಯ್ಡ್ ರಹಿತ ಮಾತ್ರೆ. 72 ಗಂಟೆಗಳೊಳಗೆ ತುರ್ತು ಗರ್ಭನಿರೋಧಕ. ಪುರುಷರಲ್ಲಿ ವ್ಯಾಸೆಕ್ಟಮಿ, ಸ್ತ್ರೀಯರಲ್ಲಿ ಟ್ಯೂಬೆಕ್ಟಮಿ.

problem.en: Match each person with a suitable method: (a) a newly married woman who wants to delay her first child by two years; (b) a couple with two children who want no more.

steps.en: (a) needs a reversible, long-acting method, such as a copper IUD or oral pills.
(b) want a permanent method: vasectomy for the husband or tubectomy for the wife.
Surgical methods are chosen only when no more children are wanted, because reversal is poor.
